name: Marc L.
body:
Thanks for this detailled analysis, Pierre. 

About h-index, I feel that the research system (« publish or perish ») was already reaching its limits even before LLMs. If AI can accelerate the transformation of this system, that could be a good thing.
 
I’d also like to build on this point: « The raison d'être of a scientist is to advance knowledge (..) » : the way we define “advancing knowledge” may be very personal and closely related to our own style, obsessions, and quest for truth. It is also definitely grounded in our history and culture: is an AI really concerned with human problems and with finding the right ways to solve them ? Finally, I feel science and art are two sides of the same coin, and I don't think LLMs really understand either of them. It may generate them, but it will miss the intention behind them.

Happy to discuss this further.
